name: sim_yinyang_carnot_szilard_geometry
claim: Carnot and Szilard cycle steps map to yin-yang geometric features on the Clifford torus

cycle_mapping.Carnot isothermal expansion: yang expanding into yin (white region grows)
cycle_mapping.Carnot adiabatic expansion: S-curve shifting (boundary moves, no area change)
cycle_mapping.Carnot isothermal compression: yin reclaiming from yang (white region shrinks)
cycle_mapping.Szilard work extraction: acting differently based on region = Axis 6
cycle_mapping.Szilard erasure: resetting the yin/yang label = Axis 3 (phase reset)

pytorch.reason: load-bearing: parametrize Clifford torus path for Carnot cycle; compute yin/yang area during each step; verify cycle closure

pyg.reason: not load-bearing: no GNN needed for thermodynamic cycle geometry

z3.reason: load-bearing: UNSAT proves paths exiting S³ (|q|>1) are not valid thermodynamic paths (thermodynamic processes stay on the manifold)

cvc5.reason: not used: z3 handles all UNSAT checks

sympy.reason: load-bearing: area of yin region = ∫∫_{θ₁-θ₂ ∈ (0,π)} dθ₁dθ₂/(4π²) = 1/2; verify analytically that the yin/yang partition is exactly equal

clifford.reason: load-bearing: represent Carnot cycle steps as multivector paths in Cl(2,0); cycle is a closed path in the e1-e2 plane; steps encode entropy up/down

geomstats.reason: not load-bearing: Riemannian geometry of cycle path not the primary claim

e3nn.reason: not load-bearing: SO3 equivariance not needed for thermodynamic cycle

rustworkx.reason: load-bearing: directed graph of 4 Carnot steps as a cycle (4-node directed cycle); verify it is a closed path (start node = end node after 4 steps)

xgi.reason: load-bearing: hyperedges connecting {Carnot_step_i, Clifford_torus_feature, Axis_j} for each of the 4 Carnot steps

toponetx.reason: not load-bearing: CW complex not required for directed cycle

gudhi.reason: not load-bearing: TDA not needed here

isothermal_expansion_region_crossing.detail: Isothermal: particle sweeping in θ₁ crosses S-curve (yin↔yang boundary) at least twice per revolution

carnot_cycle_closed_path.detail: Full Carnot cycle is a closed path on Clifford torus: start = end

carnot_cycle_stays_on_S3.detail: All Carnot cycle waypoints on Clifford torus satisfy |q|²=1: stay on S³

adiabatic_preserves_yin_yang_area.detail: Adiabatic step: θ₁-θ₂ preserved → S-curve position unchanged → no yin/yang area change

szilard_measurement_binary.detail: Szilard measurement reads θ₁-θ₂ ∈ (0,π) vs (π,2π): binary discrimination into yin or yang

landauer_erasure_half_torus.detail: Yin region = exactly half the torus (= 1 bit of entropy = Landauer erasure cost k_B ln2)

sympy_carnot_efficiency_limit.detail: Carnot efficiency η→1 as T_C→0: yin/yang boundary collapses to a point (all yang, maximum order)

z3_path_on_S3_cannot_exit.detail: z3 UNSAT: thermodynamic path stays on S³ (|q|²=1) AND exits S³ (|q|²>1) simultaneously impossible

clifford_carnot_cycle_closed.detail: Cl(2,0) Carnot cycle: step1+step2+step3+step4 = 0 (closed path in e1-e2 plane)

clifford_isothermal_steps_antiparallel.detail: Isothermal steps (1 and 3) are antiparallel: entropy increases then decreases by same amount

rustworkx_carnot_is_directed_cycle.detail: Carnot cycle: directed 4-cycle where each state has in-degree=out-degree=1 (closed path)

rustworkx_carnot_cycle_returns_to_start.detail: Following all 4 Carnot steps returns to start state A: verified closed cycle

xgi_carnot_szilard_hyperedges.detail: XGI hyperedges connect {Carnot_step, torus_feature, axis} for all 4 steps + Szilard ops

scaled_path_not_on_S3.detail: Path with scale factor 2: |2q|²=4 > 1; such paths are NOT on S³ (thermodynamically invalid)

z3_no_superthermal_process.detail: z3 UNSAT: T_work > T_H AND T_C > 0 AND T_C/T_work <= 0 are mutually impossible

adiabatic_no_region_change.detail: Adiabatic step: θ₁-θ₂ constant → yin/yang region unchanged (no thermodynamic work on boundary)

carnot_efficiency_approaches_1.detail: Carnot η→1 as T_C→0: maximum order, yin/yang boundary S-curve collapses to a point (all yang)

scurve_boundary_points.detail: Points with θ₁=θ₂ are exactly ON the S-curve boundary (diff=0): neither yin nor yang

szilard_erasure_half_area.detail: Szilard erasure resets 1 bit: yin=yang=0.5 torus area; cost = k_B ln(2) per bit

sympy_symmetric_case_exact_half.detail: At offset=0 (symmetric yin-yang): each region is exactly 1/2 by symmetry of [0,π] vs [π,2π]

clifford_net_entropy_zero.detail: Cl(2,0): step1(+e1) + step3(-e1) = 0: net entropy change over Carnot cycle = 0 (cycle closes)
